item.title: Senior Software Engineer - Remote
item.description:
Vercel is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to work on our edge infrastructure. This is a remote position.

You will work on the systems that serve billions of requests per day.

  • Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills
  • Experience with edge computing
  • Distributed systems background

item.title: Principal Engineer, Platform - San Francisco, CA
item.description:

  • Deep knowledge of web infrastructure
